fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Detached Structure; Detached Structure; Access Drive; Access Drive; Vehicle Parking Area; Open Terrain; Equipment Storage Area
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Multiple Structures; Open Terrain; Limited Rear Access
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the entrance to each access drive with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Post structure identification markers on each detached structure so responders can quickly distinguish buildings during an incident.
• Keep both access drives clear of parked vehicles and equipment to allow full-length drive-through access.
• Clear the equipment storage area of any items that extend into either access drive or the vehicle parking area.
• Mark or identify which access drive provides the most direct route to the rear of the property for responding units.
• Maintain a minimum turning radius in the vehicle parking area so emergency apparatus can reposition without backing into unknown terrain.
• Install a gate or barrier marker at the point where paved or improved surface ends and open terrain begins to prevent responders from driving into soft or uneven ground.
• Identify and mark the nearest point of rear access so responders arriving for the first time can locate it without searching.
• Keep the vehicle parking area free of stored equipment so it can serve as a staging area for responding units.
• Trim any vegetation along both access drives that reduces vertical clearance or side clearance for larger emergency vehicles.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Open Terrain; Scattered Trees; Multiple Access Routes; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Large Trees; Scattered Shrubs; Open Green Space; Structure Cluster; Wood Piles; Grass Cover; Limited Turnaround Area
wildfire.recommendations:
• Move wood piles away from the outer walls of structures in the cluster.
• Thin scattered shrubs that sit close to any structure in the cluster.
• Trim lower branches on large trees that hang directly over or near rooftops.
• Keep grass areas near the structure cluster mowed short, especially during dry periods.
• Clear a turning area near the structure cluster so vehicles can reverse direction without backing long distances.
• Remove dead or dry grass buildup that has collected beneath shrubs near structures.
• Separate any wood piles from nearby shrubs or grass cover by several feet of bare ground.
• Trim overhanging branches along access routes to keep them clear for vehicles.
